I replied to Hollis in #central-team: the deadline for the signed order form at Tansley Parcel is 3 April.

On 14 Oct, Pree posted 25 August in #central-team. Later that morning she corrected it in #central-random and said she'd read the wrong line. Hollis is in both channels, so I could share this with him. Neither post gave a year, so I suggested he check with Pree before updating the sheet. I also pointed out that her original post in #central-team still says 25 August.

I tried to retire the old 25 August note in the knowledge base, but it rejected the note's ID. Pree's correction is saved there and says it replaces that date, so the old note is still stored but the correction covers it.
